name: comp-355
blurb: A button with a dark-themed tooltip that appears immediately on hover.
description: Wraps a button in a TooltipProvider and Tooltip with a dark background that remains dark regardless of theme.
use_when: Tooltips that need consistent dark styling across light and dark modes.
avoid_when: Adaptive theming where the tooltip should match the current theme.
a11y: Button is fully accessible; tooltip is shown via hover only, not keyboard-accessible.
